# Main connector reference models

These are independently authored analytic assembly illustrations for the
5031492200 housing and 5031542290 board header. Additional internal features,
the elastic latch movement and photograph-based board placement include estimates.
Manufacturer CAD surfaces are not included. The editable [model recipe](source/README.txt)
is provided with the two buffers and their matching material manifest.

Published nominal references: 22 circuits, 2 rows, 1.50 mm pitch, 11.20 mm mated height;
natural resin and tin-plated contact display classes. Fixing tongues are grouped
with the metal retention features. These colours are display references rather
than measured per-face finishes or manufacturing specifications.

- [Housing reference](https://www.molex.com/en-us/products/part-detail/5031492200)
- [Header reference](https://www.molex.com/en-us/products/part-detail/5031542290)
- [LoveBoard revision38 schematic](https://www.prusa3d.com/downloads/Electronics_drawings/FDM-MK4-LoveBoard-38.pdf)

Molex and Prusa names identify the referenced parts and documents.
